name: Gogh Strike
author: petergpt
description: A painterly 6v6 browser shooter set in Van Gogh's Town. Pick one of twelve artists, join The Yellow House or The Independents, and fight through café streets with a signature weapon, a pistol, paint bursts and your own wall tag. First to 20 eliminations — or the higher score after three minutes — wins. Keyboard and mouse, single player against bots.
